---
title: "01 - Summarize measurement covariates by plot"
output: html_document
---

**Purpose.** Summarize all non-carbon measurement covariates from the measurements table of the GROA-AF dataset to one row per study/site/plot (`ssp_id`), restricted to agroforestry categories. Numeric variables (age, tree density, bulk density, soil texture, AF diversity) are summarized as min/max/mean, categorical variables as sorted comma-separated lists of unique values, and binary management variables as their maximum. Soil texture means are normalized so that sand + silt + clay = 100. Carbon measurements are handled in notebooks 02a-02c and joined with these covariates in notebooks 03a/03b.

**Inputs.**

- `data/groa_af/measurements.csv` (GROA-AF dataset)

**Outputs.**

- `output/intermediate/s3_by_plot.xlsx`

```{r setup}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
```

Load the measurements table, keep covariate columns, build the plot ID (`ssp_id`), and filter to agroforestry categories.
```{r load-s3}

af_cats <- c('AC', 'BP', 'COP', 'FAL', 'FOD', 'MS', 'OTH_AF', 'PAR', 'RB', 'ROT', 'SA', 'SP', 'SPC', 'TMC', 'WL')


s3_df <- read.csv(here("data", "groa_af", "measurements.csv"),
                  colClasses = "character", na.strings = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM") %>%
  select(measurement_id, study_id, site_id, plot_id, plot_name,
         prior_land_use, af_cat_as_given, af_cat, measurement_year, age_yrs, c_pool,
         trees_per_ha, bulk_density_g_cm3, soil_texture_class,
         sand_pct, silt_pct, clay_pct,
         species_af, genera_af, af_diversity, crop, crop_fao_code,
         pruning, weed_control, tillage, pest_control, burning, litter_management,
         fertilizer, irrigation, grazing) %>%
  mutate(ssp_id = paste0(study_id, ';', site_id, ';', plot_id)) %>%
  select(ssp_id, everything()) %>%
  filter(grepl(paste0(af_cats, collapse = '|'), af_cat))

```

Helper functions for parsing numeric strings (incl. ranges like "5 to 10") and compiling comma-separated lists.
```{r helpers}
parse_num <- function (num_str) {
  num_str <- num_str %>% str_remove('<') %>% str_remove('>')
  if (is.na(num_str) || num_str == '') {
    return(NA)
  } else if (!is.na(as.numeric(num_str))) {
    return(as.numeric(num_str))
  } else if (grepl('to', num_str)) {
    num_strs <- num_str %>%
      str_split_1('to') %>%
      trimws()
    return(mean(c(as.numeric(num_strs[1]), as.numeric(num_strs[2]))))
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

parse_depth <- function (dep_str) {
  if (grepl('to', dep_str)) {
    dep_strs <- dep_str %>%
      str_split_1('to') %>%
      trimws()
    return(c(as.numeric(dep_strs[1]), as.numeric(dep_strs[2])))
  }
  else {
    return(c(NA, NA))
  }
}

# function to compile comma-separated lists of data for output
make_csl <- function(vec) {
  csl_all <- paste0(vec, collapse = ', ')
  vec <- str_split_1(csl_all, pattern = ', ') %>%
    trimws() %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  vec <- vec[!is.na(vec) & vec != 'NA']
  return (paste0(vec, collapse = ', '))
}

```


Parse numeric columns (stored as text) as actual numeric values.
```{r parse-numeric}

s3_df <- s3_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(age_yrs = parse_num(age_yrs)) %>%
  mutate(trees_per_ha = parse_num(trees_per_ha)) %>%
  mutate(bulk_density_g_cm3 = parse_num(bulk_density_g_cm3)) %>%
  mutate(af_diversity = parse_num(af_diversity)) %>%
  mutate(sand_pct = parse_num(sand_pct)) %>%
  mutate(silt_pct = parse_num(silt_pct)) %>%
  mutate(clay_pct = parse_num(clay_pct))


```


For each plot (`ssp_id`), compute min/max/mean for numeric vars, comma-separated lists for categorical vars, and the max for binary management vars; then normalize soil texture means.
```{r summarize-by-plot}

num_cols <- s3_df %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()
bin_cols <- c('pruning', 'weed_control', 'tillage', 'pest_control', 'burning', 
              'litter_management', 'fertilizer', 'irrigation', 'grazing')
char_cols <- s3_df %>% select(where(is.character)) %>% select(-bin_cols) %>% names()

safe_max <- function(x) if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)

out_df <- s3_df[0,] %>%
  mutate(age_yrs_min = numeric(),
         age_yrs_max = numeric(),
         age_yrs_mean = numeric(),
         trees_per_ha_min = numeric(),
         trees_per_ha_max = numeric(),
         trees_per_ha_mean = numeric(),
         bulk_density_g_cm3_min = numeric(),
         bulk_density_g_cm3_max = numeric(),
         bulk_density_g_cm3_mean = numeric(),
         sand_pct_min = numeric(),
         sand_pct_mean = numeric(),
         sand_pct_max = numeric(),
         silt_pct_min = numeric(),
         silt_pct_mean = numeric(),
         silt_pct_max = numeric(),
         clay_pct_min = numeric(),
         clay_pct_mean = numeric(),
         clay_pct_max = numeric(),
         af_diversity_min = numeric(),
         af_diversity_max = numeric(),
         af_diversity_mean = numeric(),
         pruning = numeric(),
         weed_control = numeric(),
         tillage = numeric(),
         pest_control = numeric(),
         burning = numeric(),
         litter_management = numeric(),
         fertilizer = numeric(),
         irrigation = numeric(),
         grazing = numeric()
  ) %>%
  select(-c(age_yrs, trees_per_ha, bulk_density_g_cm3, af_diversity, 
            sand_pct, silt_pct, clay_pct))

ids <- s3_df$ssp_id %>% unique()
for (i in 1:length(ids)) {
  if (i %% 1000 == 1) {
    print(paste("Computing plot", i, '-', min(length(ids), i+999),
                'of', length(ids)))
  }
  id <- ids[i]
  plot_df <- s3_df %>% filter(ssp_id == id)
  for (col in num_cols) {
    vec <- plot_df %>% pull(col) %>% na.omit()
    if (length(vec) > 0) {
    out_df[i, paste0(col, '_min')] <- min(vec, na.rm = T)
    out_df[i, paste0(col, '_max')] <- max(vec, na.rm = T)
    out_df[i, paste0(col, '_mean')] <- mean(vec, na.rm = T)
    }
  }
  for (col in char_cols) {
    out_df[i, col] <- plot_df %>% pull(col) %>% make_csl
  }
  for (col in bin_cols) {
    vals <- plot_df %>% pull(col) %>% as.numeric()
    out_df[i, col] <- safe_max(vals)
  }
  
}

# normalize sand + silt + clay = 100
out_df <- out_df %>%
  mutate(
    # compute row-wise sum only when all three values are present
    row_sum = rowSums(pick(sand_pct_mean, silt_pct_mean, clay_pct_mean), na.rm = FALSE),
    # divide each column by the row_sum (NA row_sum leaves values unchanged)
    across(c(sand_pct_mean, silt_pct_mean, clay_pct_mean), 
           ~ ifelse(!is.na(row_sum) & row_sum > 0, 100 * .x / row_sum, .x))
  ) %>%
  select(-c(row_sum, sand_pct_min, sand_pct_max, silt_pct_min, silt_pct_max, 
            clay_pct_min, clay_pct_max))

```

Write the plot-level summary to file.
```{r write-output}

write.xlsx(out_df, here("output", "intermediate", "s3_by_plot.xlsx"), rowNames = F)

```
